subject: Azure Marketplace private offer — volume flex and reseller carveout
thread_messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@datawave.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@datawave.com
Date: Tue, 1 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer request: initial scope and channel margin constraints

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looked promising. We're working through how to purchase through Azure Marketplace and need to balance our internal list-price expectations with our distributor/reseller commitments. A few constraints from our side: 

- We need a private offer that supports monthly metering for the first 12 months (pilot -> ramp).
- Our finance requires a minimum list price on Azure of $0.18/token (to match internal cost models) while our reseller partner, EdgeLogic, needs a 22% pass-through margin off the net revenue they remit.
- Procurement also asked for a clear statement of how overage credits and true-ups will be handled if usage exceeds the pilot band.

Attached is our Private Offer Request Form with estimated monthly usage buckets. Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Anchor the Marketplace list price at $0.18/token;
2) Offer a private-offer discount that preserves EdgeLogic's 22% margin after marketplace fees/taxes; and
3) Include a one-time onboarding credit of $10k that does not impact downstream reseller margin calculations.

If this is possible, we can fast-track a PO. We're also happy to sync with your partner ops team.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Head of Platform Partnerships
DataWave Retail

Attachments: DataWave_PrivOffer_Request_Form.pdf (1 page)
From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@datawave.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 1 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer request: initial scope and channel margin constraints

Hi Maria — really appreciate the clear constraints and the form. Quick answers up front, then a couple of clarifying asks: 

1) List price anchor: We can set an Azure Marketplace list price at $0.18/token for the private offer. That will be the public-facing list price associated with the offer.
2) Reseller margin preservation: We can structure the private-offer discount so the reseller (EdgeLogic) receives a 22% pass-through on net revenue, but we need to confirm how Azure's marketplace fee (transact fee) and tax handling will be applied — those reduce the net that the reseller sees. We'll propose a margin waterfall and show the math.
3) Onboarding credit: We can give a one-time $10k onboarding credit applied as a rebate outside Marketplace billing (credit memo on Redwood invoice) to avoid altering Marketplace list/discount math.

Clarifying asks:
- Who will be listed as the billing contact on Azure (DataWave or EdgeLogic)? That changes invoice flow and where the pass-through lands.
- Are EdgeLogic's 22% margin requirements negotiable as a blended % across the first 6 months (e.g., 20% first two months, 24% after) to help smoothing?

Next steps I propose: I'll draft a private-offer proposal with three rows: pilot month band, ramp band, steady-state band with explicit per-token price, marketplace fee carveouts, and a reseller waterfall showing net to EdgeLogic. Ben from Partner Ops is cc'd to validate distributor routing and invoicing mechanics.

I'll attach a spreadsheet (proposal) and can also escalate to Azure marketplace ops if we need a special passthrough flag. Thoughts?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-private-offer-proposal.xlsx (draft pricing waterfall)
From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@datawave.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Apr 2025 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer request: initial scope and channel margin constraints

Thanks — adding partner ops detail. Karthik, good plan. A few operational notes so the pricing waterfall is implementable on Azure: 

- Azure marketplace applies a 20% transaction fee by default on transactable private offers in our region; that comes off the list price before any reseller splits. If we set list = $0.18/token, the post-transact pool is $0.144/token. EdgeLogic's 22% pass-through target would therefore need to be 22% of the post-transact pool unless we compensate via a rebate.
- To preserve EdgeLogic's 22% net, we recommend implementing a two-part mechanism: 
  a) Private-offer list price at $0.18/token;
  b) A Redwood-managed rebate (credit memo) equal to the delta required to ensure EdgeLogic nets 22% after Azure fees and taxes. That rebate can be applied monthly and tracked in our billing system.
- Onboarding credit: mark as off-marketplace rebate so it does not reduce list price (this preserves transparency for audit).
- True-ups: We support monthly true-ups with an overage credit schedule. If usage exceeds the upper band, the excess is billed at the steady-state price and the rebate is applied pro rata the following invoice. We'll call this out in the contract appendix.

Operational ask for DataWave: please confirm the billing entity (DataWave or EdgeLogic) and provide EdgeLogic's reseller Tax ID and remit instructions so we can model with taxes.

I'll coordinate with Azure ops if we need to set a custom Marketplace fee carveout tier — that sometimes requires a marketplace ticket.

- Ben Carter
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@datawave.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@datawave.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 2 Apr 2025 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer request: initial scope and channel margin constraints

Karthik / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the options. Procurement confirms DataWave will be the billing entity on Azure (we'll still route a portion to EdgeLogic per the rebate schedule). EdgeLogic's Tax ID (EIN) and remit details are in the attached form.

Two small asks before we lock: 
- Can Redwood provide the projected monthly P&L impact showing how the $10k onboarding credit and the monthly reseller rebate interact with list price/AR recognition? Procurement needs to see that for approval.
- Please include the HubSpot deal id in the proposal so our legal team can cross-reference.

If you can get a revised proposal (with waterfall math and P&L view) by EOD Friday PDT, we can sign and issue a PO the following week. Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Maria
Head of Platform Partnerships
DataWave Retail
